# Treel

> Treel is India's pioneer in Mobility Intelligence and Vehicle Digital Twin technology, transforming dynamic tyre physics and real-time vehicle telemetry into predictive fleet intelligence, commercial vehicle safety, and consumer TPMS solutions.

Treel operates across three unified product verticals built upon a proprietary tyre-first vehicle digital twin architecture:
- TMIP (Treel Mobility Intelligence Platform): Enterprise telematics and tyre intelligence for commercial fleets, passenger transport, mining, and OEMs.
- Suraksha: In-cab tyre safety systems and real-time early warning displays for commercial trucks and heavy vehicles.
- Personal TPMS: Bluetooth smart tyre pressure monitoring systems and mobile applications for passenger vehicles and two-wheelers.

## Core Products & Solutions

- [TMIP Enterprise Platform](https://treel.in/tmip): Enterprise fleet telematics, tyre sensor analytics, and predictive breakdown forecasting.
- [TMIP Vehicle Digital Twin](https://treel.in/tmip/platform/vehicle-digital-twin): Physics-informed digital twin mirroring tyre and vehicle operational dynamics.
- [TMIP Predictive Maintenance](https://treel.in/tmip/platform/predictive-maintenance): Machine-learning models predicting mechanical failure, irregular tyre wear, and blowouts.
- [TMIP Telemetry & Sensor Integration](https://treel.in/tmip/platform/telemetry): High-throughput edge telemetry processing and sensor telemetry ingestion.
- [Suraksha Commercial Fleet Safety](https://treel.in/suraksha): In-cab driver display and wheel-mounted sensors preventing roadside blowouts and tyre fires.
- [Suraksha Easy EMI Financing](https://treel.in/suraksha/emi): Accessible financing and flexible EMI schemes for truck owners and transport operators.
- [Personal TPMS](https://treel.in/personal): Smart Bluetooth tyre pressure and temperature monitoring for passenger cars and motorcycles.
- [Personal Mobile App](https://treel.in/personal/app): Mobile companion app for real-time pressure monitoring, alerts, and tyre diagnostics on Android and iOS.

## OEM Hub & Vehicle Segments

- [OEM Solutions Overview](https://treel.in/oem): Integrated factory-fitted telematics, digital twin software, and sensor solutions for vehicle manufacturers.
- [Commercial Vehicles](https://treel.in/oem/commercial-vehicle): Haulage, long-distance freight, and medium/heavy commercial trucks.
- [Buses & Passenger Transit](https://treel.in/oem/bus): Intra-city and intercity mass transit passenger fleets.
- [Four-Wheelers & Passenger Cars](https://treel.in/oem/four-wheeler): Automotive TPMS integration for passenger car OEMs.
- [Two-Wheelers](https://treel.in/oem/two-wheeler): Compact sensor design and BLE telemetry for motorcycles and scooters.
- [Mining & Heavy Haulage](https://treel.in/oem/mining): High-durability sensors for open-cast haulage, dumpers, and extreme environments.
- [Agriculture & Off-Highway](https://treel.in/oem/agriculture): Soil-compaction monitoring and tyre pressure management for tractors and farm machinery.

## Industry Applications

- [Logistics & Long-Haul Freight](https://treel.in/tmip/solutions/logistics): Fuel optimization, tyre mileage maximization, and roadside breakdown elimination.
- [Passenger Express & Intercity Fleets](https://treel.in/tmip/solutions/passenger-transport): Passenger safety, puncture prevention, and on-time service reliability.
- [Infrastructure & Construction Fleets](https://treel.in/tmip/solutions/construction): Heavy tipper monitoring and severe-duty uptime preservation.
- [Mining & Quarry Operations](https://treel.in/tmip/solutions/mining): High-load OTR tyre analytics and payload-pressure correlation.

## Technology & Engineering

- [Vehicle Digital Twin Architecture](https://treel.in/vehicle-digital-twin): Deep physics engine correlating tyre footprint pressure, temperature spikes, and vehicle velocity.
- [Data Infrastructure](https://treel.in/data-infrastructure): High-concurrency telemetry streaming pipeline processing millions of vehicle data points daily.
- [Technology Overview](https://treel.in/technology): Edge computing architecture, sensor telemetry, and cloud predictive analytics.
- [Research & Engineering Papers](https://treel.in/research): Scientific publications and technical whitepapers on tyre mechanics and vehicle intelligence.
